Q5651.reason: The 'as is' clause disclaims implied warranties of quality but not the express description of the car as a 1964 model, which was part of the basis of the bargain.

Q5672.reason: If the shooter's acquittal rested on self-defense, the killing was justified and no crime occurred, whereas insanity is a personal excuse that doesn't shield the instigator.

Q8537.reason: Separating the concept from its justification lets the definition of punishment stay value-neutral so justification can be argued independently.
